Hi Emily —

Thanks again for sharing the RFP. Attached is a concise implementation plan focused on minimizing customer impact during the migration from your current inference endpoint to Redwood Dedicated. Highlights: 

- Proposed staging/canary window: week of June 7 — primary canary execution June 7–9 (3 business days).
- Traffic steering: staged ramp (10% / 25% / 50% / 100%) with 24–48h observation windows between steps.
- Integration touchpoints: API contract validation, metrics telemetry (latency, error-rate), and prefix/KV cache warmup plan.
- DB/write handling: read-only for first canary; full write ramp after green light.
- Rollback: immediate traffic revert + 30-minute service isolation step, then full rollback if key metrics breach thresholds.

Attached: Futura_RFP_Implementation_Plan_v1.pdf (high-level timeline + responsibilities).
Can you confirm: preferred blackout windows for your apps and any compliance gating (SOC2 evidence owners) we should expect? Also if the June 7–9 window is workable for your ops team.

If that looks good I'll loop in our implementation lead (Marissa) and SRE (Rishi) with a proposed hour-by-hour runbook for the canary.

3) Security: we need SOC2 Type II artifact and a filled security questionnaire. Please attach the SOC2 report and a completed security questionnaire template.

Karthik / team / Emily —

Attached is a concise canary-runbook and an integration checklist. Summary of the runbook and answers to Emily's points: 

- Traffic mode: start with production traffic mirrored to Redwood in parallel (no write-through) for the first 24 hours to validate end-to-end inference behavior. After green-for-read, open 10% live traffic for 12 hours and observe metrics. If stable, progress to 25% then 50% across 48-hour windows.

- Hour-by-hour for June 7 (day 1 - mirror):
  08:00 — pre-checks (schema, contract validation, certs)
  09:00 — enable mirror mode (no writes) via traffic proxy (proxyctl set-mode mirror --target futura)
  10:00 — begin automated prefix/KV cache warm-up (30–60m)
  12:00 — run synthetic regression tests & smoke tests (latency, top-k correctness)
  15:00 — health assessment; if pass, schedule 10% live for next day

- Rollback sequence (brief):
  1) Pause traffic ramp and switch proxy to 0% live / mirror-only (proxyctl set-weight futura 0)
  2) Revert config to previous endpoint (proxyctl set-backend futura @prod-old)
  3) Re-run smoke tests and check data-plane integrity (DB commits, event backfills)
  4) Escalate to on-call SRE if post-rollback anomalies persist (pager: rishi_oncall).
  Target RTO for rollback action: 30 minutes from detection to traffic revert; full remediation within 6 hours.

- Security artifacts: Rishi will attach SOC2 pointer and completed security questionnaire.

- Cost delta: Grace will provide numbers; preliminary estimate: +12% monthly for Dedicated at their Q3 projected usage (detailed breakdown to follow).

Attachments: canary-runbook.md (MD, 40KB), integration-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 55KB)

Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

Hi Emily / Procurement / Michael —

Thanks for the questions and patience while we consolidated details. Short answers and the plan we propose: 

1) Traffic mode: mirror-first (no writes) on June 7, then 10% live on June 8 (12h), 25% on June 9 (24h) if metrics remain green. Full phased rollout target week of June 14 (10% -> 50% -> 100% across 3 days with 24–48h observation windows).

2) Rollback & RTO: Kicked by metric breach (p95 > 350ms or error-rate > 1.2% sustained for 15m) or manual ops request. Immediate action sequence (expected <30m to revert traffic): 
   - proxyctl set-weight futura 0  (stop live traffic)
   - proxyctl set-backend futura @prod-old (point back to current production)
   - re-run smoke tests and confirm DB integrity
   - notify stakeholders and open incident if anomalies persist
   Full remediation window: targeted 6 hours. Contact list: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com (on-call), marissa_cole@redwood.com (implementation lead), karthik_iyer@redwood.com (architect).

3) Security artifacts: attached is our completed security responses spreadsheet and pointer to SOC2 Type II (see attachment Futura_RFP_Security_Responses.xlsx and link to secure evidence in the related links). If you need the full SOC2 PDF under an NDA, we can provision it to your security mailbox.

4) Cost estimate: Grace is preparing the detailed delta, but high-level expected Dedicated premium is ~+12% monthly relative to hosted for your projected Q3 volumes; see HubSpot deal FD-8921 for preliminary numbers.

5) Next steps: please confirm the June 7–9 canary window. Once you confirm we'll:
   - finalize hour-by-hour runbook (attached canary-runbook.md)
   - provision a short alignment call (30 min) to walk the ops runbook (I can host Wed or Thu morning next week)
